query: Fremantle Western Australia taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
source: taxi-fare.com.au (Perth/WA taxi rates, applies to Fremantle as part of WA regulated area)
snippet: A typical metered taxi in Perth/WA costs about A$16 for a short 5 km trip and around A$31 for a 12 km cross-town run on the Western Australia daytime meter, which starts with a A$5.40 flagfall. In Perth, taxi and Uber use the same Department of Transport WA meter/maximum tariff. Rates verified 26 May 2026. No Fremantle-specific per-km figure was found separately from the WA-wide rate.
